items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: This boy Daffy, he took it. ... We started working for him. ... Alan Daffy. ... So, then we played at American Legion Hall, Carnival, Carnival, Carnival.

ctx.x: Not by the pumping station, you mean further back? Oh yeah, way back. I got you.

That's way back. And so, I played about two days there for him. And, well, we left from there and then, so, well, went back and played for Larry again. You know what I mean? And then, paused again. So then after that this boy took it over. What's his name again? Mills. He took it. We played for him. We played for him. So, and finally, well, after that, when he lost out, well, we saw that new man took it. This boy Daffy, he took it. Daffy, yeah. He took it. We started working for him. See? So, well, then we…
